name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages Nginx web serving for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, TLS, security headers, rate limiting, Fail2ban, firewall rules, sysctl settings, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis with Redis authentication, Fedora-compatible PID and log directories, service enablement, and cleanup of generated Redis configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a FastAPI tutorial application with Python, PostgreSQL, a Git checkout, virtual environment, dependencies, database and user setup, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
